content: Paulus nu Rom kuwa ŋga kukulna

Gabat kame nane Paulus waŋ poŋga Itali kilke mbol kuwa ŋga nu muliŋ kilanu taŋgo afu ndoŋ kilmba kame gabat ande wai mbolŋge patikinaig. Kame gabat nyunu Yulius. Nane Sesar tuku kame mbal. Ye Lukas nane ndoŋ kan.
Waŋ inum Asia ma tugu mbolŋge kundu mindek ibeŋ ka kambim bafuna le sine poŋgigeŋ. Waŋ ta Adramitium tumbraŋ suŋgo mbolŋge minna tuku. Masedonia taŋgo Aristarkus nu Tesalonikanu nu sine ndoŋ kageŋ.
Sine kumba mafena le Sidon tumbraŋ suŋgo mbolŋge ibeŋ kageŋ. Tumbraŋ taŋge Yulius nu Paulus mbolŋge wam mayemba nuŋe gulab kame afu sotuwa le turwaig ŋga sana le sine kageŋ.
Luka pro waŋ poŋga kumba bubre tumailamŋge prona le sine bubre kua ka Siprus nuy ŋaiŋam kumam limba kageŋ.
Kumba ka Silisia le Pamfilia ma liniŋmba ka Lisia ma tugu tumbraŋ suŋgo Miraŋge ibeŋ kageŋ le
taŋge waŋ inum Itali kilke mbol kambim bafuna le kame gabat nu waŋ ta te-silikina le sine ŋakmba waŋ ta poŋga kageŋ. Waŋ ta Aleksandria tumbraŋ suŋgo mbolŋge minna tuku.

Kumba ka bubre fare fare prona le sine minde bada suŋgoka gitmba ka Nidus tumbraŋ suŋgo patugeŋ. Pakarka kambim tuku bubreŋge tukulsiŋgina le sine kumba ka Kreta nuy ndinam kumam kumba piyal make make kageŋ.
Piyal make dubimba minde bada suŋgoka kumba ma ande nyunu Kundu Mayenu taŋge ibeŋ kageŋ. Ma ta tugumŋge tumbraŋ suŋgo ande nyunu Lasea minna.
Zu mbal nyamagaŋ kusrekanu ait suŋgo buk kugana le sine dalka mingeŋ tukunu Paulus nu bubre suŋgo tiŋgam tuku ait prote ŋga nu ndek nane saniŋgina:
Taŋgo kame, sine waŋ poŋga maŋ kambim bafube ta sine piti ande te-silinuŋgig. Agaŋ ndende waŋ ŋak sine taŋgo turmba ŋgisinuŋgig. Ye taŋamba kamusmba saket ŋgina kande
kame gabat taŋgo nu Paulus tuku pasa nda isanu sukmba waŋ kulat taŋgo waŋ miro nale tuku pasa ndo ismba dubina.

Sine Kundu Mayenuŋge mingeŋ ta bubre ait mbolŋge mine mayewam kumuŋ kuga tukunu nane gudommba kambim saka sine Feniks kine tumbe ŋginaig. Feniks nu nuy ta tuku kundu ande. Ma ta bubre kua ka mine mayewam kumuŋ. Nane taŋge bubre ait kugawa ŋga tairŋga minam sakinaig.
Bubre taleu fudiŋmba fitna le ariya kile sine kab ŋga saka aŋga didika Kreta nuy make make kageŋ.
Sine kumba dir kageŋ le Kreta nuy kumamŋge bubre suŋgo ndekina. Bubre ta nyunu Duŋe Yawan.
Ndeka waŋ kaduna le sine waŋ mbilmba yalmbim fugumba taŋaig ŋgigeŋ le bubreŋge sine mbitisiŋgina le kageŋ.
Sine kumba ka ka nuy ande fudiŋndo nyunu Kauda ndinam kumam kumba make make kageŋ ta minde bada suŋgoka diŋgi ŋgisikikat ŋga te-mbolmba waŋ mbolŋge pilgeŋ sulumba kageŋ.
Diŋgi te-mbolmba waŋ fetkikat ŋga nane ŋgirpenu muli kareŋnumbi kuse likinaig. Afrika ma paranu mbolŋge waŋ ndiŋkikat ŋga kuru-kuruka lai kile-ibeŋkinaig le bubreŋge waŋ mbitina le kageŋ.
Bubre yu suŋgo tiŋga sine kilmba kulisokŋga ka mafena le waŋ bulkam tuku agaŋ ndende afu yu pankinaig.
Kumba ka maŋ furirmba mafena le naŋgine waimbi waŋ tuku agaŋ afu pankinaig.
Kageŋ ka ait afu ma dabuka pa guwa tiŋgina le sine ki mbai kaŋger ndakigeŋ. Bubre yu suk suk nda tiŋga sine kilmba kublisiŋgina le sine wamdus mayenu pro kinaig le ŋgisikamŋgig ŋgigeŋ.

Nane ait kuennu isukuse ndakinaig le Paulus nu nane ŋgamukŋge tiŋga saniŋgina: Taŋgo kame, tane ye tuku pasa ismba Kreta nuy mbolŋge mingeŋ kande sine piti teŋen te-sili ndaka waŋ mbolŋge agaŋ ŋakmba kumumbi minig kande.
Tane wamdus fulil ndaka saŋgri tiŋgap. Sine taŋgo ŋakmba ŋgisike nda. Waŋ ndo ŋgisikamŋgat.
Ye Kuate tuku taŋgo ye nu mbariŋet tuku. Furir nu eŋel ande kukulat le pro ye sayat:
Paulus ne siŋka gabat suŋgo Sesar tugum kaŋgat. Ne kuru kuru ndaka. Kuate nu ne turnuwa le ne mbolŋge nane ŋakmba mine mayewamŋgaig ŋgina.
Ye Kuate tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋget. Nu pasa sayat ta kumuwamŋgat. Ta tuku tane wamdus fulil ndaka saŋgri tiŋgap.
Bubreŋge waŋ mbitiwa le nuy ande mbol prowamŋgat ŋgina.
Kusem armba kugana le furir ait ta sine Adria yu mbol fare fare pinderka kumba furir ŋgamu waŋ tuku piro mbal sine kilke ande patuweg kande ŋga idusmba minnaig.
Taŋamba nane ndek muli agaŋ ande pitinu ŋak yu butonu katesewam tuku bukŋga didika burka 40 mita taŋaŋ kaŋgernaig. Maŋ dirdirka kumba bukŋga didika burkinaig ta 30 mita.
Waŋ tuku piro mbal mbuŋ mbolŋge waŋ fetkikat ŋga waŋ pine mbolŋge aŋga bailkamba pankinaig sulumba ma purfewa ŋga yabaŋmba minnaig.
Kile waŋ tuku piro mbal kua kambim saka aŋga afu waŋ ndumor mbol pankam kineg ŋga diŋgi kuklimba yu mbol pilnaig le
Paulus nu kaŋgerka kame mbal naŋgine gabat turmba saniŋgina: Nane si waŋ kusrewaig ta tane ŋgisinuŋgaig ŋgina.
Taŋakina le kame mbal diŋgi tuku muli pike pugurkinaig le ake faitka kina.
Mafewam patukina le Paulus nu nane isukuswaig ŋga sarsarniŋmba saniŋgina: Tane kusem armba ŋgisinu tuku wamdus fulilka nyamagaŋ afu tugusemba nye ndakinaig.
Tane nyamagaŋ afu kilmba nyap ŋget. Nyamagaŋ ta taŋgine ŋgarosu saŋgri pilewam tuku. Sine kume nda. Ŋakmba mage minamŋgig ŋga saniŋgina.
Nu pasa ta sakina sulumba nu bret afu kilmba Kuate gare pasa tuna sulumba nane ŋakmba am mbolŋge fetfetmba nyina le
nane wam ta kaŋgermba wamdus bulkinaig le nane mata nyamagaŋ afu kilmba nyinaig.
Sine waŋ mbolŋge mingeŋ mbal ta 276.
Nane ŋakmba isukusnaig sulumba waŋ bulkuwa ŋga wit ŋakmba kilmba yu pankinaig.
Mafena le ma ande kaŋgermba ŋginŋganka kundu ande kaŋgermba sine ka siŋge ibeŋ kambim tagobe ŋginaig.
Nane ndek aŋga ŋakmba muli pike pugurka kusreka ulum muli kuklinaig sulumba kile ndumor mbolŋge lai ta kuklimba te-duŋga piyalŋge ibeŋ kambim tuku kageŋ.
Kageŋ ka yu toŋgel tiŋganu ma ta mbolŋge waŋ ma paranu poŋga ndiŋkina le yu mbalo sugo sugo tiŋga waŋ pine kumam katnaig le fetkina.
Fetkina le muliŋ kilanu mbal ibeŋ ka kua kubekaig ŋga kame mbal nane bale farkam bafunaig le
kame mbal tuku suŋgo nu Paulus turam tuku idusmba nane tuku wamdus muku serniŋgina. Taŋamba nu sine ŋakmba sasiŋgina: Tane kage kila mbal amboŋga pateŋga kageka kape.
Tane kage gilai mbal ail baŋ ko waŋ tuku ail isu afu kilmba kageka kape ŋgina le sine ŋakmba kageka kumba ka piyalŋge kumumbi promba ibeŋ ka tabek kageŋ.
